name: Currents API
label: Currents API
description: Currents API official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: search, latest, available_languages, available_regions. Docs: https://currentsapi.services/en/docs/. Currents API terms. Authorization header is the API key. Publisher copyright remains. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Currents API request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: search | latest | available_languages | available_regions. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'search'.

schema.label: category
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `category` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: country
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `country` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: end_date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `end_date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: keywords
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `keywords` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: language
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `language` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: start_date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `start_date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: search, latest, available_languages, available_regions.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `header`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
